title: Vehicle-to-Infrastructure IEEE 802.11ad Wi-Fi dataset
evidence_level: usable files; full archive checksum verified; independent derived tables
inspected: Two GPS CSV exports, two application-traffic CSV exports, 38 pcap files, prefixes of both monitor-frame CSV exports.
scope: 60 GHz fixed AP, one moving car with client and third radio; NTP over separate control network; onboard GPS independent of application timestamps.
limitations: No hardware PPS endpoint-delay reference. The observer pcap is a single collection point. The 2021 GPS logger and device timestamps differ by more than one hour. Two pcap files end partway through an additional record header.

title: SLATE-PTP: A Spine–Leaf Architecture Timestamps and Evaluation Dataset for IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol Benchmarking
evidence_level: usable files; full archive checksum verified; independent derived tables
inspected: All 45 native hardware timestamp CSVs; README; ptp_pipeline.ipynb (_safe_int and Ptp4lProcessor).
scope: Wired switched-network reference for timing assumptions in distributed systems. Hardware timestamp exchange under controlled offered load and placement. No moving robots.
limitations: External 1 PPS is described in the paper. Archive does not include a coincident independent offset sample for each packet. File-level directional statistics include residual clock offset and network time; reference notebook converts epoch ns through binary64.
